t: This is the site of the former City of London Maternity Hospital. Founded in 1750, it served for more than two centuries before closing in 1983, when it was folded into the obstetric unit at the Whittington Hospital. Among the people born here is Jeffrey Archer. He was an MP for Louth in Lincolnshire in the early 1970s, then reinvented himself as a novelist. His third novel, Kane and Abel, from 1979, remains one of the best-selling books in the world, and his books have sold more than three hundred million copies worldwide.
